title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents today for follow-up regarding mood symptoms.

HPI
Patient reports mood has been relatively stable since the last visit. He denies any acute changes in mood, sleep, or appetite since the last evaluation. He states adherence to his current medication regimen has been good. He reports feeling generally stable and managing daily activities without difficulty.

Medication List
Sertraline 100 mg daily

Exam
Vitals signs stable. Mental status exam reveals patient is alert and oriented x 3. Affect and mood are appropriate to stated mood. No signs of acute distress observed.

Assessment
Problem List
1. Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate.

Plan
The patient's condition of major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate, is stable at this visit. We will monitor symptoms and continue the current medication plan. Patient is advised to continue taking all medications as prescribed and to report any worsening symptoms immediately. Follow up scheduled in four weeks.
explanations: The provider addressed recurrent moderate major depression: F33.1. Severity matters; unspecified recurrent MDD (F33.9) does not map to a V28 HCC.

distractors.why: The condition was addressed at the visit.
